title: Heavenly Eye Descends
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji was drowning in despair, an old yet familiar voice pierced through his Mental Sea—'The method to break the chess game lies within you.' It was the voice of his father, Chen Xuan.

text.content: Just as Chen Ji prepared to execute the Second Elder, a blood-colored rift tore open in the sky, and a giant eye composed of countless stars slowly opened from the crack—the power of the Heavenly Eye had descended directly. That gaze pressed down on Chen Ji's shoulders like solid matter, and his Tianji Record Fragment shuddered violently, as if encountering its natural enemy. Chen Ji felt his Heavenly Fate draining frantically, and that sensation of being observed by a superior existence made every hair on his body stand on end.

dialogue.content: 'Dare an ant like you pry into Heavenly Secrets?' The voice did not come from outside but resounded directly in Chen Ji's Mental Sea, shaking him until blood oozed from his seven orifices. The massive stellar eye rotated slowly, its pupil reflecting Chen Ji's bedraggled figure. 'The Tianji Record Fragment is merely a chess piece I set down. You think yourself a Chess Player—you are but a fool being manipulated.'

text.content: Chen Ji felt every meridian in his body burning like wildfire, and the text on the Tianji Record Fragment flashed madly, seemingly resisting the Heaven's Mandate's suppression. He gritted his teeth, veins bulging on his forehead, yet discovered he could not move an inch. That pressure descending from the heavens had surpassed any范畴 he could comprehend—this was not a压制 of cultivation realm, but Heaven's Will itself denying his existence.

dialogue.content: 'Your father Chen Xuan was equally presumptuous in his time.' The Heavenly Eye's voice carried a hint of mockery. 'He believed he had found a solution to break free, yet merely added another move on my chessboard. From today, the range of your Death Prophecy expands tenfold.'

Second Elder Ling Yuan was enveloped by a sphere of blood-colored light, slowly rising. He gazed at Chen Ji, pinned motionless beneath the Heavenly Eye's pressure, and let out a sharp,刺耳狂笑: 'Hahaha! Chen Ji, do you see? This is the fate of those who defy the Heavenly Way! What do you think you are? Nothing but a dog raised by the Tianji Record!'

text.content: Chen Ji was pressed into the ground by that oppressive might, yet he stared fixedly at Ling Yuan, a mocking arc curling at the corner of his lips. Though he could not move, his mouth could still speak: 'A dog? Ling Yuan, you don't even qualify to be a dog. Why doesn't the Heavenly Eye kill me? Because it cannot.' These words made the Heavenly Eye's pupil slightly contract, as if it hadn't expected an ant to dare show defiance before it.

dialogue.content: 'Cannot kill you?' The Heavenly Eye snorted coldly, and a blood-colored thunderbolt descended from the heavens, striking directly toward Chen Ji's crown. Just as the thunder was about to touch his head, the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly erupted with dazzling azure light, barely blocking this strike, but Chen Ji spat out a large mouthful of blood, his face instantly turning as pale as paper.

text.content: 'See? That is your limit.' The Heavenly Eye's voice carried not a shred of emotion. 'Today I spare your life to let you witness personally as those you care about die one by one. Su Qingyao, Ye Qing, Chen Nian... their fates will all end because of you. This is the price of prying into Heavenly Secrets.'

Chen Ji knelt on the ground, blood dripping from his chin, yet he did not lower his head. His mind raced swiftly—Heavenly Fate had already drained by nearly a third, and the Tianji Record's foresight ability could not be used again in the short term. But his gaze remained cold as iron, memorizing everything. Ling Yuan, your arrogance today, I Chen Ji have recorded it. When the Heavenly Eye departs, you will still meet your end.

choice.prompt: Facing the Heavenly Eye's absolute pressure, Chen Ji must make a choice—bow for survival, or use his broken body to clash against this invincible existence?

choices.description: With a broken body, burn Heavenly Fate to directly oppose the Heavenly Eye, even if crushed to dust, let this lofty existence know that an ant also has the heart to shake a tree.
choices.visible_reward: The Heavenly Eye temporarily retreats, buying a moment to breathe
choices.risk_hint: May directly trigger the Death Prophecy and fall on the spot

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly raised his head, his eyes bursting with resolute light. He no longer suppressed the Heavenly Fate within him, letting that power surge out like a flood. The Tianji Record Fragment erupted with unprecedented brilliance, standing in distant opposition to the Heavenly Eye.

dialogue.content: 'Heaven? You are merely the cage confining this heaven and earth!' Chen Ji roared through gritted teeth, burning Heavenly Fate to unleash the Tianji Record's full potential. 'Today, even if I die, I shall make this pair of broken eyes见识见识 what is called a fool's fury!'

choices.description: Now is not the time to oppose Heaven. Preserve your useful body, secretly lay plans, wait until the timing is ripe before deciding high ground with this Heaven. Remember every humiliation, repay it a hundredfold in the future.
choices.visible_reward: Preserve strength, after the Heavenly Eye retreats Ling Yuan still falls under Chen Ji's control
choices.risk_hint: May be viewed as cowardly, affecting the trajectory of subsequent plot

text.content: Chen Ji slowly lowered his head, deeply concealing the fire of rage in his eyes. He knew that now clashing head-on with the Heavenly Eye would be like an egg dashing against a rock. Heavenly Fate could still support him through three more glimpses of the future—he could not waste them here.

dialogue.content: "...I understand." Chen Ji's voice was hoarse and low. He didn't lift his head, but a subtle curve appeared at the corner of his mouth. "The will of Heaven's Dao... Chen Ji has received its lesson."

choices.description: The Eye of Heaven's Dao said it couldn't kill him—this was a flaw. Using the Tianji Record's foresight ability, he would gamble on a blind spot in Heaven's Dao's will, fighting for a sliver of survival.
choices.visible_reward: Glimpsing a thread of Heaven's Dao's operating pattern
choices.risk_hint: The foresight might fail, and it would consume precious Heavenly Fate

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils contracted slightly, a flash of inspiration striking his mind—the Eye of Heaven's Dao said it couldn't kill him, this was absolutely not an empty threat. He immediately activated the Tianji Record's foresight ability, consuming fifteen points of Heavenly Fate, peering into the Eye of Heaven's Dao's trajectory within these three breaths.

The scene from the Tianji Record unfolded in Chen Ji's Mental Sea—he saw it! The Eye of Heaven's Dao's power was waning. Its forced descent today had already consumed massive amounts of Heaven's Dao's power. It wouldn't last much longer! Three breaths, no, two breaths!

The Eye of Heaven's Dao seemed to sense something, its pupil contracting sharply. It stared at Chen Ji, as if truly examining this ant for the first time: "You are peering at me?" For the first time, a hint of... uncertainty entered that voice.

dialogue.content: "Interesting." The Eye of Heaven's Dao's voice grew cold. "A fragment of the Tianji Record, and it still allows you to glimpse a thread of Heavenly Secrets. Unfortunately, this little cleverness won't save you." With that, the colossal eye of stars slowly closed, and the blood-colored fissure began to heal as well. "Remember, the chess game is already set. You cannot escape."

text.content: Second Elder Ling Yuan was wrapped in that blood-colored light, slowly rising into the fissure. He looked back down at Chen Ji, his eyes full of madness and venomous hatred: "Chen Ji, I will return. When that time comes, I want to personally watch the people you care about die before you!" His laughter echoed across heaven and earth, filled with twisted glee.

The blood-colored fissure completely sealed shut, the Eye of Heaven's Dao vanished into the Void. But that terrifying pressure still lingered in the air,久久不散. Chen Ji knelt in place, his whole body trembling, yet not from fear, but from rage. His fists were deeply embedded in the soil, his fingernails seeping blood. Ling Yuan, the Eye of Heaven's Dao... this debt, Chen Ji has taken note of.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji slowly stood up, wiping the blood from the corner of his mouth. His voice was hoarse but terrifyingly calm: "Father, you said the method to break the chess game lies within me." He looked down at his own hands, feeling the remaining Heavenly Fate within his body. "I will find it. I definitely will."

text.content: Rapid footsteps came from the distance—it was Su Qingyao. She flew on her sword, and seeing Chen Ji covered in blood, her expression changed drastically: "Chen Ji! What happened to you?" She landed beside Chen Ji, reaching out to support him, but Chen Ji gently evaded her touch.

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao's brow furrowed tightly. She noticed something unusual in Chen Ji's eyes—it wasn't anger, nor despair, but a kind of... coldness she had never seen before. "What happened? Where is Ling Yuan?" Her voice carried a hint of urgency.

text.content: Chen Ji lifted his head, looking at Su Qingyao, a meaningful curve appearing at the corner of his mouth: "Senior Sister Su, the sky of the Tianqing Sect is about to change." He didn't explain further, only taking out from his怀 the Jade Pendant already dyed red with blood—a token left behind by Second Elder Ling Yuan.

Chen Ji tucked the jade token into his sleeve, lifting his gaze toward the direction of the Tianqing Sect, a cold light flickering in his eyes. Ling Yuan had been rescued by the Eye of Heaven's Dao, but his power within the Tianqing Sect remained. After today, the entire Tianqing Sect would know that evidence of the Second Elder's involvement with the Demonic Path was in Chen Ji's hands.

"Ling Yuan escaped, but his faction remains." Chen Ji's voice was terrifyingly calm. "The Eye of Heaven's Dao wanted to use Ling Yuan as a piece against me, but forgot one thing—even pieces have their uses." He turned to look at Su Qingyao. "Senior Sister Su, would you like to know who should truly be the one protecting the Tianqing Sect?"

choice.prompt: Chen Ji revealed part of the truth to Su Qingyao, but he still needed to decide how to arrange his next move.

choices.description: Tell Su Qingyao the full truth about the Tianji Record, his father Chen Xuan, and the Eye of Heaven's Dao, inviting her to become a true ally to jointly oppose the Heavenly Dao's chess game.
choices.visible_cost: Losing the Tianji Record's greatest secret
choices.visible_reward: Gaining Su Qingyao's complete trust, unlocking the prerequisite for "Shared Fate"
choices.risk_hint: Once trust is betrayed, it will be beyond redemption

dialogue.content: Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, making a difficult decision. He looked into Su Qingyao's eyes and slowly spoke: "Senior Sister Su, there are some things I have never told anyone. But now, I feel you should know."

text.content: Chen Ji took out the Tianji Record Fragment. The blood-stained Jade Slip gleamed with an eerie cyan light under the moonlight. Su Qingyao's pupils constricted sharply—she recognized this thing. "This is... the Tianji Record?"

choices.description: Only tell Su Qingyao the fact that Ling Yuan colluded with the Demonic Path, conceal the existence of the Tianji Record and the Eye of Heavenly Dao. Let her think she is merely investigating sect insiders, rather than being drawn into a bigger chess game.
choices.visible_cost: Cannot obtain Su Qingyao's full power
choices.visible_reward: Maintain personal mystique, continue to control the information gap
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao will eventually discover the concealed truth

dialogue.content: Chen Ji faintly smiled, handing the blood-stained jade token to Su Qingyao: "The Second Elder has secretly colluded with the Demonic Path for many years. This is evidence I just obtained from Ling Yuan. He escaped, but his people remain. Senior Sister Su, what happens next is your decision to make."

text.content: Su Qingyao took the jade token, her spiritual sense probing into it, her expression growing increasingly grave. She looked up at Chen Ji, her gaze complicated: "How did you obtain this? How much do you actually know?"

choices.description: Deliberately reveal partial information by leveraging Su Qingyao's curiosity about his identity, making her want to protect him voluntarily, thus becoming a shield against the Eye of Heavenly Dao.
choices.visible_cost: Su Qingyao might see through Chen Ji's intentions
choices.visible_reward: Bind Su Qingyao to his chariot while maintaining the initiative
choices.risk_hint: Once seen through, will forever lose Su Qingyao's trust

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly clutched his chest, staggering slightly, his face pale as paper. He looked at Su Qingyao, a flicker of vulnerability in his eyes: "Senior Sister Su, there are things... I still cannot tell you now. But please believe, everything I've done is for..."

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao's brow furrowed tightly. Instinctively, she reached out to support Chen Ji. Her intuition told her this man was hiding too many secrets, but for some reason, she couldn't muster hostility toward him. "You're injured. Let me take you for treatment."

text.content: Chen Ji slightly turned his body, evading Su Qingyao's reaching hand. His gaze passed over Su Qingyao's shoulder,看向远处的天际,声音low而exhausted:"不必了。我的伤……不是药石能治的。"这番话半真半假——天命的消耗,确实不是普通疗伤能弥补的。

Night wind swept past, lifting Chen Ji's blood-stained robe. He slowly turned around, walking toward outside the Tianqing Sect, his silhouette appearing exceptionally desolate. Su Qingyao gazed at that departing figure, an inexplicable emotion surging in her heart—she realized for the first time that this "waste" disciple carried a burden she couldn't fathom.

Just as Chen Ji was about to vanish into the night, his steps suddenly halted. In his mind, that familiar and aged voice rang out—"The method to break the chess game lies within you." It was his father Chen Xuan's voice, crossing through years of time, echoing once more in his Mental Sea.

Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. He stopped in his tracks, slowly closing his eyes as his spiritual sense dove deep into his Mental Sea. There, the Tianji Record Fragment floated within the Void, its surface cracks seemingly deeper than before. And within those fissures, Chen Ji vaguely sensed something... a seal.

dialogue.content: "Father..." Chen Ji murmured, reaching out to touch that crack. In an instant, a gentle radiance emerged from the fissure, branding a blood mark onto his palm. But he smiled—because he felt it, beneath that seal was his father's final gift to him.

text.content: Night wind howled, dispersing Chen Ji's low laughter. He raised his head, gazing at the now calm night sky, his eyes burning with unprecedented brilliance. Ling Yuan, the Eye of Heavenly Dao... you thought you'd driven me into a dead end, but little do you know, this dead end conceals the only chance for this Chen Ji to defy fate!

Just as Chen Ji was drowning in despair, an aged and familiar voice pierced through his Mental Sea—"The method to break the chess game lies within you." It was his father Chen Xuan's voice, crossing through years of time, echoing once more in his soul, carrying a tenderness and expectation that transcended life and death.
